page: Microsoft Azure DC64as_cc_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCACCV5 family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The server features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs, derived from 32 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, though it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-core processing capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores ranking in the top 25%. The server demonstrates strong memory performance, particularly in small-block cached read-only memory bandwidth (4182.07 GB/sec) and PassMark memory tests, though large-block uncached read and write bandwidths perform at average levels. Multi-threaded decompression via bzip3 and database operations, including Redis SET operations (64.27 million operations/sec), also rank in the top 25%. For machine learning workloads, the server achieves top-tier performance in text generation for small LLM models (135M), while medium model (7B) processing remains average.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated AMD EPYC hardware allocation provides high resource density and reliable compute performance without the risk of resource contention. However, the absence of local storage means users must provision external storage, which may introduce latency and additional configuration requirements. Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and strong database and multi-threaded performance, this server is highly suited for database operations, web serving, software compilation, and small-scale language model inference.
